name: smwsprites-smb3-lakitu
title: SMB3 Lakitu
description:
A Lakitu that looks like the one from SMB3. It can throw a normal or custom sprite depending on the extra bit, and also has an option to use the Extra Byte 1 (Extension) as the spawned sprite number. A boss variation of Lakitu is also included.

Note that if you want Lakitu to respawn after being killed, you should use Sonikku's Sprite Respawner.
